newsitem.title: UK: Axa Equity & Law sees record new business.
newsitem.headline: Axa Equity & Law sees record new business.

text.p: Axa Equity & Law, UK subsidiary of French insurer Axa, said on Friday it had achieved record new business in 1996, exceeding the previous record set in 1993, with a surge in pensions business.
Total UK new insurance businesss (annual premiums plus 10 percent of single premiums) was up 13 percent to 552.9 million stg.
Annual premiums rose 14 percent to 59.7 million stg and single premiums advanced 10 percent to 552.9 million stg.

"New sales of individual pensions were very strong with annual premiums showing an increase of 35 percent and single premiums advancing by 66 percent. Life annual premiums were five percent ahead," said sales and marketing manager Mitch Brown.
